More importantly, in the base version, the returned SQL string from parser.parse() is directly added to the query list without parameterization (line 148-151), meaning the dynamically constructed SQL from user input in params['q'] is embedded directly into the SQL string and executed without bound parameters, creating a SQL injection vulnerability. - MongoDB version 6.0 or better

To install MongoDB on CentOS/RHEL run:
